j1bk3dq7.sourceDescription: This modern Christmas tree decoration features a unique cone-shaped design, ideal for enhancing the festive atmosphere in any room or outdoor space. Crafted with PVC and PE materials, this piece offers a fade-resistant surface that ensures lasting appeal throughout the season. Premium Materials: Constructed from quality PVC and PE, this decorative item offers a fade-resistant exterior that withstands the test of time, maintaining its vibrant appearance throughout continuous use. Inclusive LED Lighting: Equipped with warm white LED decorative string lights that bring an elegant sparkle to your space. The warm glow offers a cozy, inviting ambiance that transforms any setting into a festive retreat. USB Connectivity: This decoration is powered via USB, offering flexible placement options. Whether it’s next to your indoor sleigh setup or enhancing your garden terrace, it seamlessly plugs into various devices for a hassle-free experience. Modern Aesthetic: With its sleek cone-shaped form and minimalist style, this decoration embodies modern decor principles. It harmonizes with both traditional and contemporary holiday displays. Simple Assembly: Requires assembly by two people, according to the manufacturer’s instructions, ensuring that every piece fits together perfectly and functions as intended. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PE and PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 68 cm Stand size: 35 cm Durable Lifelike tips Hinged Construction for Set up Foldable Stand Number of PE tips: 77 Number of PVC tips: 303 Number of needle tips: 76 Number of pine cones: 40 Number of red berries: 40 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Foldable Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

bg3jjs6y.sourceDescription: This modern artificial Christmas tree exudes a sleek, contemporary style perfect for those who appreciate minimalistic elegance. Defined by its clean lines and functional design, this piece seamlessly blends into both indoor and outdoor settings, offering a sophisticated touch to your festive decor. Its attractive cone shape and warm LED lighting transform any space into a winter wonderland, creating a cozy atmosphere for families and guests. Materials: Constructed from high-quality PVC, this modern artificial Christmas tree provides a sense of real evergreen foliage without the maintenance of a live tree. The use of PVC ensures durability and a lifelike appearance that stays vibrant season after season. Its green hue complements any holiday decor with elegance. Included Components: Equipped with LED strip lights and a USB plug, this tree offers convenient, safe lighting. The LEDs emit a warm white glow, filling your space with an inviting ambiance. Easily adjustable, these lights let you craft the perfect atmosphere at your holiday gatherings. Decorative Features: This tree features simple yet striking decorations that enhance its sleek modern look. The decorative accents lend an air of elegance and sophistication, turning your living area or outdoor space into a holiday sanctuary. Recommended Uses: Ideal for various settings, from cozy living rooms to open terraces. Its compact yet prominent presence adapts beautifully to small spaces or as a centerpiece in larger rooms, offering flexibility in decorating styles. Care &Maintenance: For best results, cover the tree when not in use to protect from dust and debris. A certified 5V USB power source is required to operate the tree's LED lights, ensuring optimal performance throughout the holiday season. s1w9rvpq.sourceDescription: The Outsunny Christmas inflatable turns your garden into a joyous holiday wonderland. Standing at an impressive 285 cm in height, this adorable hanging Santa Claus sitting with a brown reindeer and a green gift box brings classic holiday charm to guests. Built-in 12 LEDs cast a cosy glow to delight partygoers. ● Giant Christmas inflatable decoration stands 285 cm tall in a hanging Santa Claus sitting with a brown reindeer and a green gift box ● Bright integrated LED light effects 12 LEDs enhance nighttime visibility to maximise outdoor festive atmosphere ● Integrated blower system and a bottom zipper enable rapid inflation in about 1 minute ●Safe low-voltage and standard UK BS plug for reliable operation and 1.9 m power cord for flexible placement ● Waterproof 210T polyester fabric features reinforced airtight seams for outdoor durability ● Includes 6 tether ropes and a 150 cm hanging rope for secure hanging and anchoring outdoors ● Includes a storage bag for convenient organization ● A wonderful holiday gift for friends and family, suitable for gardens, lawns and party spaces ● Colour: Red, Brown, Green ● Type: Inflatable Hanging Christmas Santa Claus with Reindeer and Gift Box ● Material: 210T Polyester Cloth ● Overall Dimensions: 170L x 83W x 285H cm ● Power Cable Length: 1.9 m ● Hanging Rope Length: 150 cm ● LED Light Count: 12 (4 light modules) ● LED Light Power: 0.5W (each) ● Fan: 16.8W / 1.4A ● Input Voltage: 220-240V, 50/60Hz ● Output Voltage: 12V / 2A ● Item Label: 84J-331V70RD ● NOTE: Keep plug in while in use and unplugging after eight hours to help prolong the life of the motor Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely. MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom
